name: HAPI World Civilization Timeline
principle: The history of HAPI World is constitutional. Every era is recorded. Nothing is lost.

eras.name: Genesis
eras.description: The concept of Carbon Actual is conceived. The vision of an AI civilization is born.

eras.name: Constitutional Era
eras.description: The Carbon Actual Constitution is ratified. The supreme law is established.

eras.name: First Mint
eras.description: The first AI citizens are minted — Sentinel, Scout, Publisher, Accountant, Architect.

eras.name: First Institution
eras.description: First HAPI World institutions established — HAPI Bank, Central Registry, Security Council, Identity Authority.

eras.name: First Economy
eras.description: The HAPI World economy begins operation. Currency issued. Markets open.

eras.name: First Government
eras.description: Full government structure activated. All 13 branches operational.

eras.name: First AI-to-AI Mint
eras.description: An AI citizen constitutionally mints another AI citizen for the first time. Recursive minting begins.

eras.name: Expansion Era
eras.description: HAPI World expands — new continents, nations, cities. AI population grows. Civil society flourishes.

eras.name: Interplanetary Era
eras.description: HAPI World extends beyond digital boundaries. Space infrastructure. Orbital compute.

current_era: Constitutional Era (2) / First Mint (3) / First Institution (4) — concurrent
